main_body: Red theater seat seen straight from the front: a tall backrest panel with a thin pink cap, a dark gap row, then a seat cushion block with dark armrests at the sides.
top_band: Light pink strip on rows 2-3, only on the backrest cap, with no horizontal seat surface seen from above. A lighter pink band on the cushion at rows 10-11 reads as the cushion's front face.
evidence: In the middle column, rows 2-3 are a thin light cap on the backrest. Rows 4-8 are a flat mid-red panel and row 9 is a dark gap. Rows 10-12 are a cushion front, then a dark base at row 13. The seat's top surface is never visible, so there is no 1-row front-edge highlight and no eave shadow. The cushion and backrest are flat vertical faces, the same failure as the 'thin seat' and 'front elevation' guide drawings.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark red-brown that follows the material, which is good. Shading has only about 4 red steps (highlight, light, mid, dark). The backrest and cushion are large, nearly flat fills with a few lighter highlight pixels and no grain, fabric texture or speckle. Each tile carries only about 3-5 colours, well below the reference stall and well, which have tiles, grain and per-element shading.
